note.en: Across your week, include pressing, raising, pulling and rotation; count the shoulder work done in chest and back sessions, and let the shoulders recover before the next hard session.
note.zh: 一周的训练里，推举、抬臂、后拉和旋转都要有；胸部、背部训练里肩膀出的力也要算进去，等肩部恢复了再做下一次吃力的训练。

title.en: One way to arrange a shoulder session (an example, not a prescription)
title.zh: 一种肩部训练课的安排（示例，不是处方）

note.en: Rehearse the arm path without a load or with very light dumbbells before the main lift; this is preparation, not tiring work.
note.zh: 主项之前，先空手或用很轻的哑铃熟悉抬臂的路线；这是准备，不要练到累。

note.en: Choose this as the main press only after learning how to lift and return the bar safely; build from a manageable training bar.
note.zh: 先学会安全地取杠和放回杠架，再把它当主项推举；从自己控制得住的训练杠开始。

note.en: Add a controlled backward pull while the chest remains supported and the shoulders feel comfortable.
note.zh: 胸口始终靠在凳上，在肩膀舒服的范围里有控制地往后拉。

note.en: Use lighter arm raises after the main movements, without swinging or chasing height.
note.zh: 主项之后，用较轻的重量做侧平举，不借摆动，也不追求抬得更高。

note.en: Finish with light, controlled rotation only while you can keep the elbow and trunk steady.
note.zh: 最后用轻重量做有控制的旋转，手肘和躯干始终稳住。

note.en: Practise the opposite rotation with the same attention to control, treating it as fitness practice rather than rehabilitation.
note.zh: 反方向的旋转一样注重控制；这里把它当作健身练习，不是康复处方。

note.en: This is an example selection, not a checklist to complete the whole exercise catalogue. Pike push-ups are an alternative press once learned; pulldowns and pullovers can be placed with back work instead. Keep demanding multi-joint work before tiring isolation work, rest until movement is controlled again, and progress only when the current version feels easy.
note.zh: 这是一种选法，不是要你把整个动作列表都做完。学会折髋俯卧撑后，可以用它代替推举；直臂下拉和仰卧上拉也可以放进背部训练。较吃力的多关节动作放在疲劳之前，单关节动作放在后面；休息到动作重新稳得住再继续，同样的做法变轻松了再加难。
